biggest_catch: The friend must open their account in person at a TD Store - online and phone account openings are not eligible.
catches: Referring client can receive a $100 bonus for each friend who opens an account with the referrer's unique Share the Green code and qualifies.
Up to ten (10) Share the Green bonuses ($1,000 total value) within a calendar year.
Referring client must have an existing TD personal checking account and be enrolled in Online Banking.

Referred client must: provide the friend's unique code at account opening, open a TD personal checking account at a TD Store, and either receive a qualifying direct deposit of at least $250 within 60 days or complete 15 qualifying TD Visa debit card purchases within 60 days.
Referred client must not have an existing TD personal checking account, one closed in the preceding 12 months, or have received a Share the Green bonus before.
Bonuses are credited no later than 95 days from the new account opening date.
If the checking account is closed by either party within 6 months after opening and the bonus was paid, TD may deduct it at closing.
Referral bonuses may be reported via IRS Form 1099.
TD employees and non-US residents are not eligible; can't use your own referral code.
Offer may be withdrawn at any time.

steps: Enroll in Online Banking and get your unique Share the Green code.
Share the code with a friend.
Friend opens a TD personal checking account at a TD Store using your code.
Friend receives a $250+ direct deposit or makes 15 debit purchases within 60 days.
You receive $100 per referral (up to $1,000/year), credited no later than 95 days after account opening.
